decision_basis.D13_interpretation: severe regression occurs on the required dynamic callback and PreCrush path even without a submitted cut

skip_rationale: Every permitted dynamic revision retains the callback/PreCrush path already associated with a zero-cut lost certificate; tree/all-cuts/rank-4 alternatives weakly increase work or cut volume, and rank-2 cannot remove that path. No predeclared evidence supports opening a second candidate after a severe two-role certificate regression.
